video_title: Thumbs Up For Baylor's Scheierman's 3rd Media Day 👍

quotes.speaker: Baylor Scheierman
quotes.summary_phrase: Baylor Scheierman focused on improving his explosiveness and finishing around the rim this offseason.
quotes.excerpt: I just think I have continued to improve my body, my explosiveness, my quickness
quotes.quote: I just think I have continued to improve my body, my explosiveness, my quickness, along with ball handling and finishing around the rim. I feel like those were areas I could improve on and then obviously keeping the tools sharp with shooting and all that stuff too. So I feel really good about where I am at and just excited for the year.
quotes.social_post: Baylor Scheierman says he has focused on improving his body, explosiveness, and finishing around the rim this offseason. He feels good about his progress and is excited for the upcoming year.

quotes.speaker: Baylor Scheierman
quotes.summary_phrase: Baylor Scheierman credits consistent nutrition and training for his physical transformation.
quotes.excerpt: nutrition has been a big part of it as well
quotes.quote: I think it is really just consistency with it and then also like nutrition has been a big part of it as well. And I credit like Matt Gould and the nutrition staff as well for for the transformation starting two years ago when I got here. But it is really just the consistent daily deposits into both those areas that has helped me grow.
quotes.social_post: Baylor Scheierman credits his physical transformation to consistency and the work of Matt Gould and the nutrition staff. He says daily deposits into his nutrition and training have helped him grow.

quotes.speaker: Baylor Scheierman
quotes.summary_phrase: Baylor Scheierman remains focused on daily improvement and his confidence in impacting winning.
quotes.excerpt: I have the ultimate confidence in myself
quotes.quote: I don't know. I think maybe a little bit. But at the same time I try not to really think about things like that deeply. For me I was just worried about continuing to get better and improve and to me it is really all about confidence and obviously like I have the ultimate confidence in myself and I just take it a day at a time and try to improve every day and put my best foot forward and you know I really think that like I said I feel really good about where I am at and super confident about how I can help impact this team and help impact winning.
quotes.social_post: Baylor Scheierman says he tries not to think too deeply about the trade, focusing instead on daily improvement. He says he has the ultimate confidence in himself and is ready to help the Celtics win.
